title: Almond Consumption Lowers Cholesterol without Weight Gain - Ballard Psychiatry
abstract:
#### What is the evidence supporting the effectiveness of daily almond consumption in reducing cardiometabolic risk factors?  
Studies have shown that daily almond consumption can lead to a reduction in cardiometabolic risk factors. There is convincing evidence that consuming whole almonds on a daily basis can lower blood LDL cholesterol levels, although the effects on other cardiometabolic risk factors such as endothelial function are not yet fully understood \[3]. Furthermore, a study comparing almond to other similarly nutrient-rich foods found that almonds specifically have a beneficial impact on lipids and lipoproteins \[4].  
However, the effects of almond consumption on other cardiometabolic risk factors such as glucose and insulin are controversial \[2]. Despite this, a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies examining the effect of nut consumption on risk factors for chronic diseases showed that nut consumption overall is associated with improvements in several cardiometabolic parameters \[5].
#### How does the amount of daily almond consumption affect the reduction of cardiometabolic risk factors?  
Numerous studies have investigated the effects of daily almond consumption on cardiometabolic risk factors, including blood lipids and lipoproteins. A controlled feeding trial was conducted to compare the effects of a pecan-rich diet with those of a control diet. The study showed that pecans reduced cardiometabolic risk factors in healthy middle-aged and older adults \[1].  
In contrast, there is convincing evidence that daily whole almond consumption lowers blood LDL cholesterol concentrations, but the effects on other cardiometabolic risk factors such as endothelial function are still being investigated \[3].  
Furthermore, a systematic review and meta-analysis examined the effects of almond consumption on cardiometabolic risk factors and found improvements in several parameters, but its effects were controversial in some cases \[9]. Similarly, the effect of pistachios consumption on cardiometabolic risk factors were included in another systematic review and meta-analysis.
### Effects of Daily Almond Consumption on Cardiometabolic Risk and Abdominal Adiposity in Healthy Adults with Elevated LDL-Cholesterol: A Randomized Control Trial
